## Multiple series

We can plot multiple series by calling `plot` twice:

However, watch what happens if we don't call this in the same cell:
code_block:

    from scipy import stats

    plt.plot([2, 4, 6, 10], [1, 2, 3, 10])
    plt.plot([1, 2, 3, 10], [2, 4, 6, 10])
    
    plt.plot([2, 4, 6, 10], [1, 2, 3, 10])
    
    plt.plot([1, 2, 3, 10], [2, 4, 6, 10])
